This iconic dish offers a delightful balance of sweet, tangy, and subtly spicy flavors, making it a universally appealing comfort food. Perfect for a hearty lunch or an exquisite dinner, it promises an authentic taste of India right in your home kitchen.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine chicken pieces with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, Kashmiri red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, and salt. Mix well, cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or preferably 2-4 hours to allow flavors to develop.

instructions.title: Cook the Chicken
instructions.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken pieces and cook in batches until lightly browned on all sides and mostly cooked through. Remove chicken and set aside on a plate.

instructions.title: Prepare the Makhani Sauce Base
instructions.text: In the same pan, melt the remaining 3 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent and soft, about 5-7 minutes. Add green cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, and cloves; cook for another minute until fragrant, stirring constantly.

instructions.title: Build the Sauce
instructions.text: Stir in the tomato puree, soaked cashews (if using, make sure to drain them first), and sugar. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and oil begins to separate from the edges.

instructions.title: Blend the Sauce
instructions.text: Remove the whole spices (cardamom, cinnamon, cloves) from the sauce if you can easily find them. Carefully transfer the sauce mixture to a blender or use an immersion blender to blend until completely smooth. For an extra silky texture, pass the sauce through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pan. Return the smooth sauce to the pan.

instructions.title: Combine and Finish
instructions.text: Add the previously cooked chicken pieces back into the smooth sauce. Stir in the crushed fenugreek leaves (Kasuri Methi) and heavy cream. Simmer for another 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the chicken to finish cooking through and absorb the rich sauce. Taste and adjust salt or sugar if needed. Garnish generously with fresh cilantro before serving hot.

tips: For the best flavor, marinate the chicken for at least 2 hours, or even overnight. The longer it marinates, the more tender and flavorful the chicken will be.
Using Kashmiri red chili powder gives a beautiful red color without excessive heat. If unavailable, use paprika for color and a pinch of cayenne for mild spice.

To achieve an extra smooth, restaurant-quality sauce, blend the sauce base very thoroughly and then pass it through a fine-mesh sieve after blending. This removes any small bits of onion or tomato skin.
article:
Butter Chicken, known in India as Murgh Makhani, is more than just a dish; it’s an experience. This iconic Indian lunch recipe has captured hearts worldwide with its rich, creamy texture and harmonious blend of savory and subtly sweet flavors. Originating from the bustling kitchens of Delhi, Butter Chicken has become a global ambassador for Indian cuisine, celebrated for its comforting warmth and irresistible taste. Whether you're a seasoned chef or a culinary novice, mastering this beloved curry is a rewarding journey that promises delicious results. Get ready to dive into the world of Murgh Makhani and discover how to bring this restaurant-quality delight to your own table.

## What is Butter Chicken Murgh Makhani?

At its heart, Butter Chicken Murgh Makhani is a classic Indian curry featuring succulent pieces of chicken enveloped in a luscious, vibrant tomato and cream-based sauce. The name "Murgh Makhani" literally translates to "chicken with butter," hinting at the richness that defines this dish. Its origins trace back to the 1950s at the Moti Mahal restaurant in Delhi, where chefs innovated a way to use leftover tandoori chicken by simmering it in a rich tomato gravy. The result was a culinary masterpiece that quickly gained fame.

What sets Butter Chicken apart is its unique flavor profile: mildly spiced, creamy, slightly sweet, and tangy, with an unmistakable smoky undertone from the cooked chicken. It's often less fiery than other Indian curries, making it a favorite for those who prefer milder flavors without compromising on depth. The sauce typically gets its body from pureed tomatoes and its velvety texture from a generous amount of butter, cream, and often cashews or almonds. It’s a perfect Indian lunch recipe, offering a satisfying and flavorful meal that truly warms the soul.

## Ingredients You Need for Butter Chicken

Crafting the perfect Butter Chicken requires a careful selection of ingredients, ensuring each component contributes to the overall richness and flavor.

For the Chicken Marinade:
*   1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
*   1/2 cup plain full-fat yogurt
*   1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste
*   1 teaspoon red chili powder (Kashmiri chili powder for color)
*   1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
*   1 teaspoon garam masala
*   1/2 teaspoon salt

For the Murgh Makhani Sauce:
*   4 tablespoons unsalted butter
*   1 large onion, finely chopped
*   1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste
*   1 (28 ounce) can crushed tomatoes (or 4-5 medium fresh tomatoes, pureed)
*   1/4 cup raw cashews (soaked in warm water for 15-20 minutes, then drained) or 2 tablespoons almond meal
*   1 teaspoon red chili powder (Kashmiri for color, regular for heat)
*   1 teaspoon garam masala
*   1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
*   1 teaspoon sugar (or to taste, balances tanginess)
*   1 teaspoon kasoori methi (dried fenugreek leaves), lightly crushed
*   1/2 cup heavy cream (or more, to taste)
*   Salt to taste
*   Optional: 1/4 cup water or chicken broth, if needed for consistency

For Garnish:
*   Fresh cilantro, chopped

## Step-by-Step Instructions to Make Butter Chicken

Making homemade Butter Chicken is a rewarding process. Follow these steps for a truly authentic experience.

Step 1: Marinate the Chicken
In a large bowl, combine the chicken pieces with all the marinade ingredients. Mix well, ensuring the chicken is evenly coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or ideally 2-4 hours, or even overnight for maximum flavor and tenderness.

Step 2: Cook the Chicken
Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) or a grill pan on medium-high heat. Skewer the marinated chicken pieces or arrange them in a single layer on a baking sheet. Cook for 15-20 minutes in the oven, or grill/pan-fry until the chicken is cooked through with slightly charred edges. Set aside.

Step 3: Prepare the Sauce Base
In a large pot or Dutch oven, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and sauté until they turn translucent and lightly golden, about 8-10 minutes. Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the crushed tomatoes, soaked cashews (or almond meal), red chili powder, garam masala, turmeric powder, and salt. Mix well and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 15-20 minutes, until the sauce thickens and the oil starts to separate from the sides.

Step 4: Blend the Sauce
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes. Carefully transfer the sauce mixture to a blender. Blend until completely smooth. For an extra velvety texture, you can pass the blended sauce through a fine-mesh sieve back into the pot.

Step 5: Finish the Curry
Return the smooth sauce to the pot and place it back on medium-low heat. Stir in the sugar and kasoori methi (crush it between your palms before adding to release its aroma). Add the heavy cream and mix well. Simmer gently for 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the sauce to warm through. If the sauce is too thick, add a little water or chicken broth to reach your desired consistency.

Step 6: Combine and Serve
Add the cooked chicken pieces to the simmering sauce. Stir gently to coat the chicken completely. Let it simmer for another 5 minutes to ensure the chicken absorbs the rich flavors of the Murgh Makhani. Garnish generously with fresh chopped cilantro and serve immediately.

## Pro Tips for the Best Butter Chicken Results

Achieving that perfect, restaurant-quality Butter Chicken at home is entirely possible with a few expert tips:

*   **Marination is Key:** Don't skimp on marination time. The longer the chicken marinates, the more tender and flavorful it will become. Overnight is ideal for the best Butter Chicken.
*   **Charred Chicken for Depth:** Cooking the chicken until it has slightly charred edges, whether on a grill, in a hot pan, or under a broiler, adds a crucial smoky depth that mimics traditional tandoori cooking and elevates the overall flavor of the Murgh Makhani.
*   **Blend Until Silky Smooth:** For an authentic, velvety texture, blend the sauce thoroughly. Straining it through a fine-mesh sieve after blending will remove any tiny bits of onion or cashew, resulting in an incredibly smooth and luxurious gravy.
*   **Don't Skip Kasoori Methi:** Dried fenugreek leaves (kasoori methi) are non-negotiable for authentic Butter Chicken flavor. Lightly toast them in a dry pan for a few seconds before crushing and adding them to the sauce to release their full aroma.
*   **Balance Your Flavors:** Taste the sauce and adjust the sugar, salt, and chili powder to your preference. The sweetness balances the tang of the tomatoes and the richness of the cream.

## Serving Suggestions for Murgh Makhani

Butter Chicken is a versatile dish that pairs wonderfully with a variety of accompaniments, making for a complete and satisfying Indian lunch. The most classic pairing is with fluffy Basmati rice, which soaks up the rich, creamy sauce beautifully. For a truly authentic experience, serve it alongside warm, pillowy naan bread, perfect for scooping up every last drop of the Murgh Makhani gravy. Other excellent bread options include roti, paratha, or even simple chapati.

To complement the richness of the Butter Chicken, consider adding a fresh side salad of sliced cucumbers, onions, and tomatoes, dressed lightly with lemon juice. A cooling raita (yogurt with cucumber and spices) also provides a lovely contrast to the creamy curry. Don't forget a wedge of lime to squeeze over the top for a burst of fresh acidity just before eating.

## Variations and Substitutions for Butter Chicken

While the classic Butter Chicken is a beloved staple, there are many ways to adapt this recipe to suit different dietary needs or preferences without sacrificing flavor.

*   **Vegetarian Alternatives:** For a delicious meat-free version, substitute the chicken with paneer (Indian cottage cheese), tofu, or a medley of roasted vegetables like cauliflower and bell peppers. These variations are often called Paneer Makhani or Vegetable Makhani and are equally delightful.
*   **Dairy-Free Options:** To make Murgh Makhani dairy-free, use a plant-based butter alternative and swap heavy cream for full-fat coconut milk or cashew cream. The sauce will still retain its richness and creamy texture.
*   **Nut-Free:** If you have nut allergies, you can omit the cashews and instead use a tablespoon of gram flour (besan) or a small amount of cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce, ensuring it's cooked out thoroughly.
*   **Spice Level:** Adjust the amount of red chili powder to control the heat. For a spicier kick, you can add a finely chopped green chili along with the ginger-garlic paste.
*   **Smoky Flavor Enhancement:** For an extra layer of smoky flavor reminiscent of a tandoor, you can employ the "dhungar" method: place a small, burning charcoal piece in a heatproof bowl within the pot of finished curry, drizzle a teaspoon of ghee over it, and quickly cover the pot for a few minutes.

Butter Chicken Murgh Makhani is truly a culinary jewel, offering a symphony of flavors and textures that tantalize the palate. Whether you're making it for a special occasion or a comforting weekday lunch, this Indian classic promises to deliver warmth, satisfaction, and an unforgettable dining experience. Embrace the process, experiment with the flavors, and enjoy the incredible journey of creating your very own perfect Butter Chicken.
